title: AccountHoldingsSnapshot
description: Standardized Tier 1 Account Holdings & Cash Ledger Snapshot emitted by broker account fetchers across domestic and international accounts.

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the account matching config/investment_ways.yaml (e.g., angelone, indmoney_us).

broker.description: Broker service provider identifier (e.g., angelone, indmoney).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the account snapshot was obtained.

total_invested.description: Sum of total invested capital across all holdings.

total_current_value.description: Sum of current market value across all holdings.

unrealized_pnl.description: Total unrealized profit or loss in account currency.

unrealized_pnl_pct.description: Total unrealized return percentage across holdings.

available_cash.description: Unallocated settled cash balance available in ledger.

holdings_count.description: Total count of distinct equity holding positions.

funds_invested.description: Total net deposited funds in account currency (Pay-ins minus Pay-outs, falling back to total_invested).

account_xirr.description: Annualized money-weighted rate of return percentage (XIRR) based on account cashflows, or null if insufficient history.

available_cash.description: Cash available for equity delivery purchases.

collateral.description: Collateral value from pledged shares or securities.

utilised.description: Margin currently utilized for open derivative/trading positions.

net_margin.description: Total net available trading margin (available_cash + collateral - utilised).

ticker.description: Canonical exchange ticker symbol (e.g. INFY, AAPL).

name.description: Display name of the company or fund.

exchange.description: Primary listing exchange (e.g., NSE, BSE, NASDAQ, NYSE).

quantity.description: Quantity held (integer for Indian equities, fractional allowed for US).

average_price.description: Volume-weighted average purchase price per share.

cmp.description: Current Market Price per share in account currency.

invested_value.description: Total invested cost for this position (quantity * average_price).

current_value.description: Current market valuation of this position (quantity * cmp).

unrealized_pnl.description: Unrealized profit or loss for this position.

unrealized_pnl_pct.description: Unrealized return percentage for this position.

fractional_shares.description: True when fractional shares are supported and held.

buy_date.description: Earliest or primary acquisition date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

sector.description: Economic sector classification (e.g., Information Technology, Financials, Healthcare).

attribution.description: Account lot-level attribution tranches for blended strategy holdings.

accounts_blended.description: Summary metadata of accounts blended into this snapshot.

ledger.description: Historical bank transactions ledger (pay-ins, pay-outs, dividends) associated with the account.
